m.advanced.algorithmHint: How VIIRS detections become Aqua-equivalent. The error is the measured monthly error in this region.
m.advanced.anomalyNote: Anomalies always use blue for below normal, grey for normal and red for above.
m.advanced.baselineHint: The same calendar month over 2003–2022; anomalies are measured against it.
m.advanced.cmapHint: Cividis is safe for colour-vision deficiency.
m.advanced.title: Advanced
m.alg.aqua_only.d: One satellite throughout; its overpass drifts to about 15:15 after 2021.
m.alg.ensemble.d: The ensemble with a static 2012–2021 calibration.
m.alg.ensemble_adaptive.d: Average of a per-month ratio and a seasonal FRP curve, weighted toward recent years.
m.alg.ensemble_geom_adaptive.d: Like the adaptive ensemble, with FRP curves by expected Aqua pixel size.
m.alg.frp_season_adaptive.d: Probability that Aqua sees each cell, by FRP and season.
m.alg.naive.d: MODIS until 2011, then VIIRS as is; a false jump at 2012.
m.alg.ratio.d: One number VIIRS is always multiplied by.
m.alg.ratio_month_adaptive.d: Aqua ÷ S-NPP ratio for each calendar month.
m.alg.raw_rows.d: Counts every FIRMS row with duplicates; not comparable.
m.app.name: Firms
m.chat.footer: Runs on feeef Cloud AI, billed to your wallet. It can be wrong; check figures in the calendar.
m.chat.intro.body: The assistant reads the calendar, comparisons and detections, and sets the region and period so you see the answer.
m.chat.intro.title: Ask about fires
m.chat.label: Message to the assistant
m.chat.pageHint: It answers and sets the region and period in the bar above.
m.chat.placeholder: Ask about a region’s fires or a period…
m.chat.signedOut.body: The assistant runs with your feeef account and is billed to your wallet. Every other page works without signing in.
m.chat.signedOut.title: Sign in to use the assistant
m.chat.suggest.1: How were Punjab’s fires over the last 5 years?
m.chat.suggest.2: Was the latest month in Portugal above normal?
m.chat.suggest.3: Which method is most accurate in South Sudan?
m.compare.annualHint: Good methods stay continuous at 2012; the naive splice jumps.
m.compare.benchHint: The full study on {regions}, ranked by mean held-out-year error.
m.compare.benchNote: The naive splice is off by hundreds of percent because it counts duplicate pixels and satellites.
m.compare.evalHint: Monthly error when Aqua is hidden and predicted from VIIRS (2012–2021). Lower is better; the best in each column is shaded.
m.compare.evalNote: Held-out year: each year is predicted from the others. Forward: calibrated on 2012–2017, tested on 2018–2021.
m.compare.heldout: Held-out years: actual Aqua vs estimate
m.compare.heldoutHint: Each month of 2012–2021 estimated without seeing Aqua that year. Dashed is the actual Aqua.
m.compare.noiseFloor: Noise floor about {pct}%: even two identical instruments differ this much month to month, so no method can do better.
m.compare.title: Comparing harmonization methods
m.dev.col.name: Name
m.dev.deleteBody: Every tool using it stops working at once. This can’t be undone.
m.dev.exHint.claude: Put it in .mcp.json for Claude Code, or in Claude Desktop’s settings.
m.dev.exHint.curl: Calls the get_calendar tool directly over JSON-RPC.
m.dev.exHint.rest: Every read endpoint is public and needs no key.
m.dev.hint: Connect Claude, Cursor or your own code to the same calendar and detections you see here.
m.dev.keyNameHint: So you remember where it’s used, like Claude on my laptop
m.dev.keysHint: A key is shown once when created and stored hashed.
m.dev.mcpHint: Stateless Streamable HTTP. Send your personal key in the Authorization header.
m.dev.noKeysBody: Create one key per tool you connect, so you can delete it alone if needed.
m.dev.secretOnce: This key won’t be shown again. Copy it into your tool’s settings.
m.dev.signedOutBody: Keys are personal and tied to your feeef account.
m.dev.title: MCP and the API
m.download.failed: The picture wasn’t saved. Try again.
m.download.label: Download
m.entry.body: MODIS and VIIRS detections become one count of Aqua-equivalent fire-days, so every month compares with past years without a false jump when the satellite changes.
m.entry.feature.assistant: An assistant that answers and sets the filters
m.entry.feature.calendar: Monthly calendar and anomalies for each region
m.entry.feature.globe: Every fire pixel at its real size on the globe
m.entry.headline: One fire calendar from 2001 to today
m.error.forbidden: You don’t have permission for this.
m.error.network: Couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
m.error.notFound: Not found. It may have been removed or renamed.
m.error.server: The server had a problem. Nothing was lost; try again in a moment.
m.globe.buildFailed: The server couldn’t prepare this day. Choose another day.
m.globe.building: The server is fetching this day from FIRMS…
m.globe.firstCorner: Tap the first corner on the globe
m.globe.nearbyHint: White outlines on the globe are the same snapshot’s pixels.
m.globe.pickDayHint: The last 60 days can be shown; a day not ready yet is fetched from FIRMS when you ask for it.
m.globe.samePass: {count, plural, one {# pixel} other {# pixels}} in the same snapshot
m.kpi.errorNone: Not evaluated: it is the reference
m.kpi.noFullYear: No full year in the period
m.kpi.totalHint: {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} · Aqua-equivalent
m.live.aquaNote: One day is very noisy (clouds, timing); the measured error is for monthly totals. Aqua’s orbit drifted, so it now passes about {time} instead of 13:30, and its own count isn’t “the truth” after 2022.
m.live.calGlobal: Global calibration (all regions pooled), for this month.
m.live.inside: The box is inside the calibrated region “{region}”, so its calibration is used.
m.live.noViirs: No VIIRS detections in the box.
m.live.none: No detections in this box today.
m.live.title: Inside the box
m.login.body: Sign in with your feeef account to use the assistant, build new regions and create MCP keys. Everything else works without signing in.
m.login.title: Sign in
m.overview.annualHint: Dashed lines mark VIIRS (2012) and the Aqua drift (2022).
m.overview.asTable: Show the figures as a table
m.overview.calendarAnomalyHint: Each month against the {baseline} of the same month in 2003–2022.
m.overview.calendarHint: Aqua-equivalent fire-days per month. The bar at the end of each row is the year’s total.
m.overview.lowFire: This region has few fires, so monthly figures are noisy (measured monthly error about {pct}%). Rely on seasonal or annual totals, or build a wider region.
m.overview.partialYears: Years not fully inside the period count only their available months.
m.params.label: Parameters
m.period.pickIntro: Pick the first and last month; each month counts in full.
m.regions.buildingHint: You can close this; the region appears in the list when it’s done.
m.regions.col.name: Region
m.regions.doneHint: The region is ready and in the list.
m.regions.failedHint: The build didn’t finish. Check the log below, fix the country or box, and try again.
m.regions.form.bboxHint: Decimal degrees west, south, east, north. Like 35.1,33,36.7,34.7
m.regions.form.countryHint: In English with _ for spaces, like Lebanon or South_Sudan
m.regions.form.countryRule: Write the country in English with _ for spaces, like South_Sudan.
m.regions.form.intro: The server downloads the country’s FIRMS archive, cuts it to the box, then calibrates and evaluates the algorithms. This can take a few minutes.
m.regions.form.name: Identifier
m.regions.form.nameHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and _, like lebanon_south
m.regions.form.nameRequired: Enter an identifier for the region.
m.regions.form.nameRule: Use lowercase Latin letters, digits and _ only, starting with a letter (2–32).
m.regions.form.nameTaken: That identifier is taken. Choose another.
m.regions.form.title: Display name
m.regions.form.titleHint: As shown in lists, like South Lebanon
m.regions.form.titleRequired: Enter the name shown in lists.
m.regions.hint: Each region has an archive from 2001, a real evaluation of the algorithms and its own calibration.
m.regions.levelNote: Fire level comes from Aqua’s mean monthly fire-days in 2012–2021: low under 150, high over 1000.
m.regions.noneBody: Add a region with its FIRMS country name and box, and its calendar is built from 2001.
m.regions.title: Calibrated regions
m.search.bboxError: Enter four numbers W,S,E,N with west below east and south below north.
m.search.confHint: MODIS as a percent, VIIRS low/nominal/high
m.search.daysHint: One to five days ending on the date
m.search.minFrpHint: Fire radiative power in MW; 0 includes all
m.search.noneBody: Try more days, more sources, or lower confidence and FRP.
m.search.regionHint: Search inside a calibrated region’s box
m.search.sourcesHint: Leave all empty to include every source
m.search.title: Fire detections
m.search.window: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} to {date}
m.shell.foot: Harmonized MODIS/VIIRS fire-days in Aqua-equivalent, 2001 to today. Data: NASA FIRMS.

m.source.VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT: VIIRS on NOAA-20, near real time
m.source.VIIRS_NOAA21_NRT: VIIRS on NOAA-21, near real time
